newsitem.title: USA: Tower Automotive files for 10.1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Tower Automotive files for 10.1 mln shares.

text.p: Tower Automotive Inc said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 10,090,000 common shares.
Of the total, 8.5 million common will be offered by the company and 1.59 million common will be sold by selling stockholders. After the offering, outstanding common will total 22,838,050 shares.
The selling stockholders include Onex Corp with 1,486,778 common for sale and J2R Partners with 103,222 common for sale, the filing said.
The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option to purchase up to 1,513,500 additional common shares.
The offering will be made through Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, PaineWebber Inc, Robert W. Baird & Co Inc, Morgan Stanley Inc and Piper Jaffray Inc.
Net proceeds will be used to pay a portion of the cash purchase price of the Automotive products Co acquisition.

Tower, based in Minneapolis, Minn., is a designer and producer of high-quality body structure components and assemblies used by major North American automotive original equipment manufactures and certain foreign OEMs with manufacturing operations in North America.
